title: 得 (de) in Chinese: HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 得 (de) to say how well someone does something: verb + 得 + adjective, sentences with an object, negatives, questions and 得 vs 的, with HSK 2 examples.
h1: How to Use 得 (de) to Describe How Someone Does Something
lede: 得 (de) comes straight after a verb and introduces a description of how the action is done: well, badly, fast, slowly, early or late. 他说得很好 means "he speaks well". It is a key grammar point of HSK 2.

paras: Subject + verb + 得 + 很 + adjective.

Put 得 directly after the verb, then the adjective that describes the action. As with adjectives on their own, the adjective usually takes 很 or another word such as 非常 or 太……了. Without one it can sound like a comparison: 他跑得快 suggests he runs faster than someone else. 得 is pronounced with a light, neutral tone.

examples.py: Nǐ jīntiān lái de hěn zǎo.
Wǒ zuótiān shuì de hěn wǎn.
examples.en: I went to bed late last night.

sections.h2: With an object: say the verb twice
paras: 得 must come right after the verb, so there is no room for an object between them. The most common learner mistake is 他说汉语得很好. There are two correct ways to say it: repeat the verb (verb + object + verb + 得 + adjective), or put the object before the verb and drop the first verb.
Both 他说汉语说得很好 and 他汉语说得很好 are correct and very common.

examples.py: Tā shuō Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.

examples.zh: 我妈妈做饭做得非常好吃。
examples.py: Wǒ māma zuò fàn zuò de fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.en: My mum is a really good cook.

examples.py: Tā zì xiě de hěn piàoliang.

paras: To say someone doesn't do something well, put 不 after 得, before the adjective: 我唱得不好. Putting 不 before the verb (我不唱得好) is wrong.
To ask, add 吗 at the end, use adjective + 不 + adjective after 得, or ask 怎么样 (how well?).

examples.py: Tā shuō de kuài bu kuài?

examples.en: How good is he at swimming?

paras: 得 and 的 sound the same, but they do different jobs. 的 comes before a noun and describes the thing or person. 得 comes after a verb and describes the action. Compare 一个很好的老师 (a very good teacher) with 教得很好 (teaches very well).

examples.py: Tā shì yí ge hěn hǎo de lǎoshī.
examples.en: She is a very good teacher.

worksheet.title: 得 (de) Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 得 (de) worksheet for HSK 2: 19 exercises (得 or 的, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 得 or 的 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: This is the food my mum made.
He is a very good doctor.
Did you sleep well last night?

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence with 得.

items.en: How good is he at swimming?
My dad is a good cook.
answers: 我爸爸做饭做得很好吃。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: I went to bed late last night.
